title: Computational Analysis of Character Development in Holocaust Testimonies

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing confusion matrices to quantify the model's tendency to overpredict positive categories (such as 'Positive' belief or 'Active' practice) compared to 'Other' or neutral categories.

Qualitatively observing model predictions to identify cases where pretraining stereotypes override specific instructions, such as incorrectly assigning positive valences to non-Jewish (e.g., Christian) religious expressions despite guidelines defining them as carrying negative valence in the context of the task.
